summary.conclusion: Zero of the 27 not-in-table Title 49a tokens (177 rows) existed as sections of 1988 U.S. Code Title 49 Appendix, and zero are omissions from the 1994 Title 49 Disposition Table. Importing raw 1988 Title 49a OCR into UscSectionOracle would recover 0 of 177 rows while introducing two-column OCR bleed. One token (3102, 5 rows) is a genuine pre-1994 positive-law Title 49 section (Pub. L. 97-449) renumbered to 49 U.S.C. § 31502 by Pub. L. 103-272 and erroneously marked `app`; nine tokens (114 rows) are current positive-law Title 49 Subtitle VII chapter numbers (correcting the earlier 14 CFR ch. III conjecture); the remaining 17 tokens (58 rows) are lost-parenthesis pinpoints, wrong-title citations, CFR parts in the U.S.C. slot, or filer/parser damage.
